Noah Park: hi all :wave: i9m Noah, joined today on Runtime infra. quick Q: i requested dual-monitor setup in the form but dont see a confirmation. who owns hardware delivery? also i9m colorblind and wondered about any accessibility preferences in our UI docs?
Tara Singh: welcome Noah!! I handle equipment requests for Platform. can you confirm your shipping address in a DM? dual monitors are fine — we usually ship within 3 business days.
Noah Park: thanks Tara, DMing address now. re: accessibility — i use high-contrast themes and would love pointers on preferred color tokens in the design system.
Asha Raman: hey Noah, welcome to the team! we have an accessibility page in the internal docs (Design System > Accessibility) that lists color tokens + WCAG targets. i9m happy to pair on small tweaks if you see anything off.
Noah Park: appreciate that Asha. small aside: i bake sourdough on weekends, happy to trade starter tips :bread:
MDM Bot: Hello Noah  Please enroll any device you plan to use: https://mdm.example.com/enroll  If you need a company laptop, reply with "need-laptop".
Noah Park: enrolling now. also, IT Support — tagging for VPN + keyboard layout (i prefer US-international).
IT Support: thanks @Noah. for VPN follow the quickstart: `sudo redwood-vpn login` then `redwood-keyboard-config us-intl`. i9ve pre-approved a monitor order; tracking email will be sent to your address. if you need an ergonomic keyboard, reply here.
Luis Ortega: welcome Noah  i9m your manager. 1:1 invite sent for tomorrow. excited to get you into a small onboarding project to run a perf test on KV caching.
Noah Park: great — thanks Luis. tiny fun fact: once accidentally brought my sourdough to a team picnic (it vanished fast). looking forward to working with y9all!
